title: Qatar conflict events -> CF log returns (null control)
hypothesis: R2 | [fertilizer-ag] Null control: Qatar GDELT conflict-event count 20d z-score > 1 leads CF Industries log returns by 3 days (+) if the NTR backtest reflects a real Qatari urea/ammonia supply shock rather than war-regime beta; trade long CF 3d [gdelt.qat.conflict_events -> finance.CF.log_return] (parent: R2-0043)
message: Null control did NOT null out: Qatar conflict z>1 -> long CF 3d gives 36 trades, hit 69%, excess +0.8%/trade, sharpe-like 2.3; pre-war fit (24 trades, 75% hit) stronger than war test (12 trades, 58%, +0.4% excess). Corr r=0.126 n=390, perm p=0.04 but Bonferroni p=0.84 -> weak correlation, decent rule; effect is fertilizer-sector-wide not NTR-specific; next test SPY for generic beta.

trade_idea.entry_rule: gdelt.qat.conflict_events rolling_zscore_20d > 1 at close -> long CF next session
trade_idea.exit_rule: close after 3 trading days (no overlapping entries)
trade_idea.caveats: Backtest on daily closes, no costs/slippage; few independent regimes; signal and target may share the war as common cause.

followup_hypothesis: R2 | [fertilizer-ag] Null control: Qatar GDELT conflict-event count 20d z-score > 1 leads SPY log returns by 3 days (+) - if the CF/NTR edge (pre-war hit 75%, war 58%) is generic equity beta this should match it, otherwise it is fertilizer-specific; trade long SPY 3d [gdelt.qat.conflict_events -> finance.SPY.log_return] (parent: R2-0142)
